results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec

All 49 body units align one-to-one with spec paragraphs in spec order (p01-p50 with p19/p20 before p17/p18 and p27 closing 'pieces', marketplace p28-p30 inside In Practice); every outline summary matches its spec paragraph's controlling idea. The three intro callouts have no spec paragraph, as expected. Small drift: In Practice ¶1's summary stresses the overview, which p32 also declares.
The reverse outline lists the same controlling ideas in the same order as sections[].paragraphs[]; no unit added, dropped, merged or reordered.
Introduction ¶3 is marked two_ideas (defines the three views and gives the roadmap), but spec p03's controlling idea assigns both to this one transition paragraph, so it is the declared shape.
In Practice ¶1 is marked two_ideas (overview of the section and the first rule), but spec p32's controlling idea declares exactly that combination; the lead and the first rule are tied by 'First'.
No other unit was marked as carrying two ideas; the When It Goes Wrong list and the conclusion's Established/Depends/Synthesis lists are list-form units whose spec shape requires several points.

Every unit serves a supporting claim: the scene and needs units S1/S2/S5, the state machines and target shape S2/S3, self-service and the refund command S4, the choices, stages and marketplace units S3, the measures S5, the failures S1/S3/S5, and the conclusion and Part IV close synthesise them. No orphan paragraph.

Each table and figure is framed by a sentence saying what it shows: the ticket table is followed by 'No system held that answer'; the notification map by 'The middle row is the one a newcomer should stare at'; the component table is announced as giving 'each component's job, the one shortcut it must never take'; the requirements table by 'the consistency column is the point'; the comparison table by 'The table's second row decides between them'; the stage table by 'The judgement'; Eva's table by 'Nothing in the target column needs a new channel'.

Quotations are interpreted: Shopify's page states are followed by 'Three rules follow'; Shopify's edit constraint by 'In plain words: once the warehouse has accepted the work...'; Narvar's claim by 'They solve the carrier half well and the order half not at all'; the Gorgias 18% by 'The safe statement... The useful statement is architectural'. The measures table is explained before it ('turn the service desk into the platform's most honest monitor') and after it by who produces which measure; adequate.

Introduction and scene boundaries express their declared relations: 'The disagreement starts with facts held in different places' (cause_effect), 'This chapter connects three views' (elaboration), 'Where we are in the order's journey' (sequence), 'The opening's three conflicting answers happened at Kestrel & Pine' (example), 'In the book's fictional reconstruction' (elaboration of the mechanism), 'The WMS kept the order In picking' (additional_support), 'The useful answer was simple' (conclusion_summary), 'Waypoint... addresses this' (problem_solution).

Needs section boundaries hold: 'No system held the answer "two parcels", so start from...' (cause_effect), 'The middle row is the one a newcomer should stare at' (emphasis), the subheading 'The order status page' carries p12's sequence from pushed messages to the pulled page (the paragraph itself has no linking phrase, but both flow readers read it as the next view), 'Shopify's documentation of its page... shows the design choices in miniature' (example), 'Three rules follow' (cause_effect), 'When the page goes silent... the customer writes in' (cause_effect), 'The safe statement... The useful statement' (contrast).

Pieces and choices boundaries hold: 'Joining the views starts from one fact about the record they read' (problem_solution), 'The lesson for the service layer' (cause_effect), 'With those states in one place, the target shape follows' (cause_effect), 'Each flow between those components' (elaboration), 'Self-service writes back through the same record, so it must read the goods state first' (cause_effect), the numbered options 1-4 (sequence), 'The table's second row decides between them' (conclusion_summary), 'The judgement' for the stages (elaboration).

Practice, failures and conclusion boundaries hold: 'In practice the design comes down to four rules' (example), the DPD/EasyPost paragraph as the instance of the first rule (example, by juxtaposition), 'Second', 'Third', 'Fourth' (additional_support), 'So far the merchant has owned the conversation... On a marketplace' (contrast), 'Personal data is the other difference' (additional_support), 'Eva's order, run through these rules' (example), 'Nothing in the target column' (conclusion_summary), 'Whether the messages pre-empt the tickets can be measured' (cause_effect), 'When one of these rules is broken' (contrast), 'The customer of the opening' (conclusion_summary), the Established/Depends on context/author's synthesis labels, 'This chapter closes Part IV' (conclusion_summary), 'Each chapter's remedy therefore' (problem_solution), and the Part V hand-off.

Both readers describe the declared problem_solution order (failure case, then needs and emitters, then the one-record shape, the choices and stages compared, practice with Eva's worked example, failures, take-away) and call the main path easy to follow; only the marketplace subsection's position is unclear to them. Points that stem only from book context the audience already knows (W2/W8, 'order hub', the scale stage names, the Double Refund, Hanna Berg and Noor Visser, iPaaS, PSP) are not counted as material for the declared reader.

The conclusion does not open 'in conclusion', does not merely restate the thesis, and adds no new idea or body evidence; the Part IV close draws on cases the audience already knows and is assigned by the spec.

p43 explains why the customer had three answers and what one record changes, and p49 gives the so-what and a course of action ('for each promise it makes after checkout... name the system on the spot... Start with two measures').

p43 returns to 'The customer of the opening had three answers' and gives her the missing answer; p48 returns to the Part IV opening's 'order that checkout confirms in seconds', as conclusion.callback requires.

The intro reader predicted every roadmap promise in order (the eleven tickets, emitters, status page and WISMO as measurement, separate states and one record, four choices and scale, marketplaces, Eva and measures, failures with the Familiar Stranger), Eva's 13-22 April messages, and all three kinds of evidence.
Same as AC-4: the cold reader's prediction from the introduction alone matches the roadmap's sections and evidence.

The reader names 'ships in two parcels' with the second leaving on the 14th, the OMS as the only emitter (none in the platform-only landscape), and that page, notifications and agent read one record showing goods per line or parcel, money and return state, not one word.

The reader states that the agent and the page show different orders and 'shipped' goes out before handover, and gives the rules: the service view reads the system that owns the goods state (helpdesk re-pointed at the OMS) and 'shipped' is triggered by the handover scan with a working tracking number.

The reader says self-cancel is allowed only before the warehouse accepts the work (afterwards a request), so self-service checks the fulfillment state, and that WISMO is measured per 100 shipped orders, including peak week, not as a share of tickets, as a signal of the notification and tracking layer.
